It provides sponge iron, pig iron, ductile iron pipe, ferro chrome, TMT, coke, and sinter, as well as ferro alloys, alloy and mild steel billets, and reinforcement steel bars and wire rods. The company offers its TMT bars under the Balaji Shakti brand. Jai Balaji Industries Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Kolkata, India.

JAYNECOIND.NS.d: Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited manufactures and sells steel products, and iron and steel castings primarily in India. It operates through Steel, Iron and Steel Castings, and Other segments.

KANCOTEA.NS.d: KANCO TEA & INDUSTRIES LIMITED is an Indian company engaged in the cultivation, processing, and sale of tea. The company owns and operates tea gardens, producing various types of tea for domestic and export markets with headquarters located in India. They focus on maintaining quality and sustainability in their tea production processes.

KARURVYSYA.NS.d: The Karur Vysya Bank Limited provides various banking and financial services for personal and corporate customers in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments.

KSL.NS.d: Kalyani Steels Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products. It provides rolled bars for various automotive applications, including crankshaft, camshaft, connecting rods, gears, transmission shafts, axle beams, steering knuckles, and others; rolled bars for engineering applications comprising alloyed steels for use in energy, railways, defense, fasteners, material handling, etc.; and steel for use in the earthmoving, cement, sugar, steel, coal, ship-building, and oilfield industries, as well as general…

NEXTMEDIA.NS.d: Next Mediaworks Limited, through its subsidiary, engages in radio broadcasting in India. It operates FM stations under the Radio One brand in Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Pune, and Ahmedabad. The company was formerly known as Mid-Day Multimedia Limited and changed its name to Next Mediaworks Limited. Next Mediaworks Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India. Next Mediaworks Limited is a subsidiary of HT Media Limited.

NIBL.NS.d: NRB Industrial Bearings Limited manufactures and sells ball and roller bearings for industrial applications in India. The company offers deep groove ball bearings, wide inner ring ball bearings and housed units, spherical and cylindrical roller bearings, bottom and needle roller bearings, and cam followers. It also operates as an agent for manufacturers to supply various types of bearings, including tapered roller bearings and linear guides.

PATINTLOG.NS.d: Patel Integrated Logistics Limited provides logistics services in India. The company engages in the co-loading of airfreight; and provision of warehousing and air cargo consolidation services. Patel Integrated Logistics Limited was founded in 1959 and is based in Mumbai, India.

POKARNA.NS.d: Pokarna Limited manufactures, processes, and sells granites and quartz surface countertops in India, the United States, China, and internationally. It offers granite products in various colors, such as acacia, black galaxy, coffee brown, flash blue, Pokarna green, sapphire blue, seaweed green, silver pearl, and vizag blue. The company also provides random slabs and tiles, as well as cut-to-size products. In addition, it manufactures and retails apparel under the Stanza brand name.

PRECOT.NS.d: Precot Limited manufactures and sells yarn and technical textile products in India. It offers normal, compact, organic, BCI, slub, doubled, gassed, and open end cotton yarns; polyester cotton blend yarns; cotton dyed yarns; and polyester sewing threads.

QPOWER.NS.d: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited, established in 2001 and based in Sangli, supplies electrical power products and services for generation, transmission, distribution and automation. Its range includes reactors, transformers, instrument transformers, line traps, capacitor banks and composite materials, along with power quality systems such as static VAR compensators and harmonic filters.

RHL.NS.d: Robust Hotels Limited is an Indian hospitality company whose main property is the five-star Hyatt Regency Chennai. Based in Chennai and established in 2007, it changed its legal name from a private limited company to a public one in October 2022.

SCILAL.NS.d: Shipping Corporation of India Land and Assets Limited was established in 2021 and is headquartered in Mumbai. Its main function is to manage and sell non-core assets, a role that stems from a demerger related to Shipping Corporation of India Limited.

SIGMA.NS.d: Sigma Solve Limited, headquartered in Ahmedabad, develops enterprise software and provides IT and IT-enabled services together with consultancy. Its offerings include CRM system development, business intelligence analytics, development of real-time applications, and web and e-commerce development.

SIGNPOST.NS.d: Signpost India Limited, headquartered in Mumbai and established in 2008, provides digital out-of-home advertising, from digital billboards on city streets to displays at bus stops. It also offers hybrid mobility products, namely e-bikes, street libraries and traffic monitoring booths.

SURANASOL.NS.d: Surana Solar Limited manufactures and sells solar panels and solar photovoltaic modules in India and internationally. It operates through Solar products, and Wind and Solar Power segments. It also generates wind and solar power; and trades in other solar related products. The company was formerly known as Surana Ventures Limited. Surana Solar Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
